entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Yeah, David, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not what I expected and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number to pull up your account?
The name is Michael Sterling. The order number should be on my file, I'm a VIP member for crying out loud. Just look it up.

Of course, Mr. Sterling. I see your VIP account right here. Thank you for your loyalty. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It doesn't matter. I don't like it. I want to return it. End of story. Process the refund.
I understand you're frustrated, sir. I'm just trying to follow our process. Looking at the delivery date, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th, which was 32 days ago.
And? Your policy is 90 days. I'm well within that. Stop wasting my time and do your job.

I see the source of the confusion, Mr. Sterling. While our apparel and most accessories do have a 90-day window, our electronic wearables like the VeloBand Pulse have a much stricter return policy due to health and safety regulations. The return window for this specific item is 10 days.
What?! Ten days? That's insane! This is completely unacceptable! I want a full refund immediately!

I'm sorry, sir, but because it has been over 30 days, it is simply too late to accept a return for this item. Our policy is very firm on this. After 20 days, for reasons of hygiene and bio-contaminant risk, we cannot take back a device that has been worn.
Hygiene? Are you kidding me?! This is a ridiculous excuse! I am a VIP customer! I expect better treatment. Get me your manager, right now! I'm not taking no for an answer.

Mr. Sterling, I understand your anger, but my manager is bound by the same health and sanitation policy. They will tell you the same thing. Once the device has been in a customer's possession for this long, we cannot in good conscience resell or even handle it as a return. It's a matter of public health.
This is the worst customer service I have ever experienced! I will be writing reviews on every single website I can find. I'll make sure everyone knows how VeloFit treats its most loyal customers!

I truly am sorry for the frustration this policy has caused. I cannot override the sanitation rules, but I do want to acknowledge your status as a valued VIP member. While a return is not possible, I can issue a 25% discount code to your account for your next purchase of any VeloFit apparel or a different accessory. It's the most I am authorized to do.
Fine! Whatever! A lousy 25 percent... It's better than nothing, I guess. This whole situation is still a joke. Just send the code. You haven't heard the last of this.
I have just applied the discount code to your account, Mr. Sterling. You will receive an email confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Goodbye. *[hangs up]*
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
